name: Nilesh Kakatkar
summary: Go backend developer with nearly 2 years of experience on CACHATTO One (C1), a hybrid-work platform that gives enterprises secure, VPN-free remote access to cloud and on-premises resources. I build the platform's multi-tenant core, high availability, WireGuard networking, real-time remote management, and Android device management.

experience.product: C1 (CACHATTO One): hybrid-work platform for secure, VPN-free remote access to cloud and on-premises resources

items.title: Multi-Tenant Platform
items.text: Helped migrate C1 from single-tenant to a centralized multi-tenant architecture, with customer-side connectors that give secure access to private network resources.
items.challenge: C1 used to run as a separate deployment per customer. The goal was one centralized platform that serves many customers while keeping each customer's resources isolated.
did: Helped move the core from a single-tenant to a centralized multi-tenant architecture
Worked on customer-side connectors that give secure access to private network resources
Kept access to each customer's resources separated inside the shared platform

items.title: Remote Management (RMM)
items.text: Built the WebSocket relay for agent-client communication, covering agent registration, authentication, and session management; began moving to WebRTC peer-to-peer.
items.challenge: Support teams need to reach and manage remote machines in real time, even when those machines sit behind firewalls.
did: Built the WebSocket relay that connects agents and clients
Handled agent registration, authentication and session management
Started moving sessions to WebRTC peer-to-peer so traffic does not always pass through the relay

items.title: Android MDM
items.text: Implemented Android device management with the Android Management API: enrolment, policy management, Pub/Sub event handling, and device-specific configurations.
items.challenge: Company Android devices have to be enrolled, held to policy and kept in sync without manual setup on each one.
did: Implemented device enrolment with the Android Management API
Built policy management for enrolled devices
Handled device events coming in through Pub/Sub
Added device-specific configurations

items.title: High Availability
items.text: Implemented primary-standby HA with database replication, failover/promotion, and node synchronization to keep C1 available during failures.
items.challenge: If the primary node goes down, remote access for every user should not stop with it.
did: Implemented a primary-standby setup
Set up database replication between the nodes
Built failover and promotion of the standby
Added node synchronization so both sides stay consistent

items.title: WireGuard Networking
items.text: Replaced script-based WireGuard management with a native Go implementation for interfaces, peers, routing, and tunnel lifecycle.
items.challenge: Tunnels were managed through scripts, which are hard to test and hard to recover when something breaks.
did: Replaced script-based WireGuard management with a native Go implementation
Covers interfaces, peers and routing
Manages the whole tunnel lifecycle from code

items.title: Architecture & Quality
items.text: Helped move C1 from a tightly to a loosely coupled design, added unit tests, and supported CI/CD adoption for automated builds and validation.
items.challenge: A tightly coupled codebase makes every change risky and slow to verify.
did: Helped move C1 from a tightly to a loosely coupled design
Added unit tests
Supported CI/CD adoption for automated builds and validation

projects.name: Go Shield
projects.subtitle: L7 Reverse Proxy & Load Balancer
projects.text: Built an L7 reverse proxy and load balancer with SSL termination, rate limiting, dynamic backend registration/removal, and Redis-backed configuration/state management.
projects.overview: A reverse proxy that sits in front of backend services, terminates SSL, spreads traffic across backends and protects them with rate limits.
features: Backends can be registered and removed while it runs
Configuration and state kept in Redis

projects.name: ShopCore
projects.subtitle: Microservices E-Commerce Platform
projects.text: Built a microservices-based e-commerce platform using gRPC for service communication, Kafka for asynchronous messaging, and database-backed services for core operations.
projects.overview: An e-commerce backend split into independent services that call each other over gRPC and pass events through Kafka.
